dedupe_keys.name: nyc planimetric database open space parks

description: The NYC planimetric base map includes an open space layer whose features, such as courts, tracks and park areas, are captured from aerial imagery according to the city's published planimetric capture rules; the dataset is the parks and open space subset of that base map. Coverage: the five boroughs of New York City. Access: free map view with exports on NYC Open Data, made public in August 2014 with rows last updated in April 2024; the portal marks the update frequency as historical data and automation as none. Licence: none stated on the dataset record; NYC Open Data terms of use apply. Caveats: a planimetric capture of surfaces, not an administrative park register, so polygons follow visible features, and it is not refreshed on a schedule. Simulation uses: mapping permeable open space for flood and heat models, and access analysis of public open space. Related records: OSM leisure=park features, the TPL ParkServe park layer and the NYC street tree census.
